title: Smoothness descends along a single fpqc base morphism
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\prime\to Y$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Suppose $g$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and surjective on underlying points. If the projection $X\times_Y Y\prime\to Y\prime$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], then $f$ is smooth. No finite presentation hypothesis on $g$, and no separatedness, properness or dimension hypothesis on $f$, is required.

source.place: Tag 02VL, lemma-descending-property-smooth (smoothness is fpqc local on the base), single flat quasi-compact surjection case; Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/LocalFlatDescent.lean:41-42.
